pages.title: Sven Wearing a Harness in a Snowy Field Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Sven from Frozen standing with a cheerful smile, broad branching antlers, and a patterned harness against snowy hills. Small snowflakes and distant fir trees surround the reindeer, while the coloring sheet combines wide body areas with finer harness diamonds, fur tufts, and split hooves.

pages.title: Frozen Sven Eating a Carrot Beside a Wooden Feeding Trough Coloring Page
pages.description: Sven eats a carrot beside a wooden feeding trough in this printable coloring page, with his large antlers rising above his shaggy neck. The raised trough holds more leafy carrots, and its plank grain and round fasteners add smaller details to a coloring sheet with generous open spaces across the reindeer's body.

pages.title: Frozen Baby Sven Pulling a Small Block of Ice Beside Young Kristoff on the Frozen Lake Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features baby Sven pulling a small ice block beside young Kristoff on a frozen lake, with distant mountains behind them. Kristoff wears a pom-pom cap and mittens while holding the rope. The coloring sheet includes little antlers, harness knots, patterned clothing trim, and rippled reflections beneath their feet.

pages.title: Frozen Sven Pulling Kristoff's Wooden Ice Sled Loaded with Neatly Stacked Ice Blocks Coloring Page
pages.description: Sven pulls Kristoff's wooden ice sled in this printable coloring page, stepping through snow with a tall stack of ice blocks behind his harness. Curved runners, slatted sides, and small cracks in the blocks distinguish the sled. Broad fur areas contrast with narrow straps and the distant fir trees on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Frozen Sven Leaning Toward Olaf's Carrot Nose During Their First Meeting in the Snowy Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page captures Sven leaning toward Olaf's carrot nose during their first meeting in a snowy forest, surrounded by layered fir branches. Olaf looks up with his twig arms spread, while Sven lowers his broad muzzle. The coloring sheet includes patterned harness straps, round snowman buttons, and gently rolling snowbanks.

pages.title: Sven Wearing a Holly Wreath and Bell Harness Coloring Page
pages.description: Sven wears a bell-covered harness and holly wreath at the castle gates in this printable coloring page inspired by Olaf's Frozen Adventure holiday scene. Pointed holly leaves and berry clusters frame his shaggy neck. The coloring sheet adds patterned straps, hanging banners, an arched gate, and broad snowdrifts around his hooves.

pages.title: Frozen Sven in Crystal Cave Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places Sven inside a crystal cave, with angular crystal clusters decorating his antlers, forehead, and back beneath a hanging row of icicles. Large faceted formations rise beside him, with smaller crystals scattered across the cave floor. The coloring sheet mixes broad body shapes with narrow facets, harness straps, and little bells.

pages.title: Frozen Sven in Wind Spirit Meadow Coloring Page
pages.description: Sven smiles in a wind spirit meadow in this printable coloring page, with curling gusts and drifting leaves weaving around his tall branching antlers. Flowers and grass frame the bottom of this close-up coloring sheet. His broad muzzle and shaggy neck offer larger spaces beside the smaller leaf veins, petals, and harness bands.

pages.title: Frozen Sven on Mountain Trail Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Sven on a mountain trail, wearing a harness and nose strap as a winding path curves between rocky slopes behind him. His head and shaggy chest fill the foreground. The coloring sheet balances large antler and fur shapes with smaller buckles, scattered stones, shrubs, and distant fir trees.

pages.title: Frozen Sven in Cozy Cabin Coloring Page
pages.description: Sven wears a patterned sweater and fringed scarf inside a cozy cabin in this printable coloring page, with a fireplace and curtained windows behind him. Zigzag bands and curved stitches provide smaller sections across his clothing. The coloring sheet also includes a hanging lantern, bottles on the mantel, and a patterned rug beneath the wooden walls.

pages.title: Frozen Sven on Icy Lake Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Sven standing on an icy lake, with a cheerful open mouth, broad antlers, and harness straps beneath distant snowy mountain peaks. Cracks divide the ice around his hooves, creating angular sections across the foreground. The coloring sheet leaves wide spaces in his body, the lake, and the outlined clouds.

pages.title: Frozen Sven in Royal Throne Room Coloring Page
pages.description: Sven sits on an ornate throne in a royal throne room in this printable coloring page, wearing a decorated harness with little hanging bells. Snowflakes cover the throne and tall window, while a reindeer banner hangs beside an arched column. The detailed coloring sheet includes scrollwork, geometric borders, curled armrests, and tiled flooring.

pages.title: Frozen Sven on Rocky Shore Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Sven standing on a rocky shore, with his harness, branching antlers, and shaggy chest framed by boulders and distant mountains. Small waves stretch across the water behind him. The coloring sheet pairs broad body patches and open sky with smaller pebbles, grass blades, hoof shapes, and narrow harness straps.
